subject: MAP intake: security runway & evidence milestones for Cleargate Capital
messages:
From: Elena Ortiz <elena.ortiz@cleargate.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
Cc: security@cleargate.com, procurement@cleargate.com
Date: Wed, 02 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP intake — security runway & evidence cadence

Hi Avery,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the latency profile looked great for our near-real-time use case. As we talked, we need to lock the mutual action plan (MAP) for evaluation and procurement so internal risk and procurement can map out the acceptance gates.

High-level asks from my side:
- A short SOC 2 summary of scope and most recent report date.
- SIG/CAIQ answers for services handling customer data (we'll run a quick review for any high-risk controls).
- Your proposed DPA draft and proposed data retention buckets (90/365/region-specific).
- A realistic timeline for hitting security acceptance (we have a product launch target mid-September).

Can you propose a MAP with milestone owners and dates so I can include it in our risk committee packet next Tuesday? We prefer a two-week cadence for evidence reviews but can accommodate a faster sprint if needed.

Best,
Elena Ortiz
Head of Platform Risk
Cleargate Capital

Attachments: none (will accept your links)

From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ortiz <elena.ortiz@cleargate.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP intake — security runway & evidence cadence

Elena — great to hear from you and glad the demo hit the mark.

We can put a concise MAP together today outlining milestones, evidence owners, and a sprint cadence that targets security acceptance by 2027-08-25 to leave a buffer before your September launch. Draft outline below — I'll follow up with the Drive link and attachments.

Proposed MAP highlights (draft):
- 2027-06-07: MAP kickoff + mutual action items sheet (Redwood owner: Avery)
- 2027-06-14: Submit SOC 2 summary + SOC 2 report redacted (Redwood -> Elena)
- 2027-06-21: Deliver SIG/CAIQ matrix (answers) + controls mapping (SRE/Trust owner: Rishi)
- 2027-07-06: DPA draft with suggested retention tiers (Legal owner: Kimberly)
- 2027-07-12 — 07-26: Evidence review sprints (two-week cycles)
- 2027-08-02: Final risk items & mitigations logged (joint)
- 2027-08-18: Security acceptance sign-off (target)

Evidence we'll share up-front: SOC2-summary-2026.pdf, SIG-CAIQ-matrix-answers.xlsx, and a starting DPA redline (DPA-draft-Cleargate-redlines.docx). We'll host the MAP doc in a shared Drive folder and keep a short change log.

Questions for your team:
1) Are there any controls you want us to prioritize in the SIG matrix (e.g., encryption, data residency, key management)?
2) Do you require a scoped SOC 2 with specific service commitments beyond standard CC controls?
3) Any procurement constraints around DocuSign (they use Adobe Sign here)?

I'll upload the files and link the MAP after internal sync with Rishi and Kim.

Thanks — Avery
Avery Johnson
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

Attachments: (will attach)

From: security@cleargate.com <security@cleargate.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Ortiz <elena.ortiz@cleargate.com>, procurement@cleargate.com
Date: Thu, 03 Jun 2027 11:26:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: MAP intake — security runway & evidence cadence

Thanks for the draft MAP, Avery. Quick clarifications from security: we will prioritize controls related to:
- Data residency and cross-border transfer restrictions for EU-origin data (we may ask for region-specific hosting or contractual commitments).
- KMS/HSM usage and key rotation cadence for customer encryption keys.
- Logging, retention windows, and availability of audit logs for a minimum of 12 months.

Specific asks: please include the following columns in the SIG matrix you provide: control owner, evidence filename, retention policy reference (e.g., "retention:365d"), and any compensating controls.

On the DPA: we have a few non-negotiable clauses on subprocessing notification and breach notification timelines (24 hours initial notice). If you can flag the clauses you expect to be negotiated, that helps speed legal review.

We will upload our standard questions into your Drive link once you share it. Also confirm whether your SOC 2 report includes the Redwood public cloud service boundary or just the hosted API layer.

Regards,
Cleargate Security Team

Attachment: none

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ortiz <elena.ortiz@cleargate.com>, security@cleargate.com
Cc: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 04 Jun 2027 16:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP intake — security runway & evidence cadence

Elena / Cleargate team — thanks for the clear priorities. I've attached the initial evidence bundle and updated the MAP in Drive with the columns requested. Quick notes inline and next steps: 

- SOC 2: attached SOC2-summary-2026.pdf is scoped to the hosted Redwood API and our inference runtime; it clarifies the control boundary and excluded dev/test environments. Report date: 2026-11-15.
- SIG/CAIQ: SIG-CAIQ-matrix-answers.xlsx contains per-control answers and an "evidence file" column that maps to filenames in the Drive folder. We included comments where we expect follow-up (e.g., KMS hold for customer-managed keys).
- DPA: DPA-draft-Cleargate-redlines.docx includes flags on subprocessing, breach notification, and a proposed 30/365/730 retention tier suggestion. Kimberly will drive legal questions and propose alternate language for the 24-hour notification carveout.

We confirm audit logs are retained for 12 months by default, with the option to extend via the Dedicated/Private deployment add-on. For EU-origin data, we provided our regional routing options and an annex with residency commitments (see Drive: /annex/residency).

Next steps I propose:
1) Procurement/legal reviews DPA (procurement@cleargate.com) — target comment date 2027-06-11.
2) Security does a first-pass on SIG answers by 2027-06-14.
3) Joint evidence sprint week of 2027-06-21 (two-week sprint cadence thereafter).

I'll hold weekly 30-minute syncs starting 2027-06-08 to triage open items — calendar invite coming from me.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Trust & Reliability, Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOC2-summary-2026.pdf; SIG-CAIQ-matrix-answers.xlsx; DPA-draft-Cleargate-redlines.docx
